description: Réseau de transport Impulsyon à La Roche-sur-Yon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. Stops, schedules and circuits of the Impulsyon transport network in GTFS format in La Roche-sur-Yon and real-time alerts. Coverage: La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Impulsyon transport network in La Roche-sur-Yon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. Its keywords include transports, mobilite, impulsyon, arrets, horaires. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, JSON. The listing shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
